description: A single feature/value pill in the welcome screen's horizontally-scrollable chip row. Preserves the original four chips (Couples-first, Shared goals, Smart insights, Invite-only households) on a glass surface instead of the old low-contrast lavender pill.

microIcon.note: leading dot/Ionicon for brand tint without low-contrast text

list.container: FlatList horizontal, showsHorizontalScrollIndicator false, contentContainerStyle gap spacing.sm

stateTreatments.loading: 3 Skeleton pills (radius.full) in place of the row; reuse components/Skeleton.tsx

accessibility.grouping: Announce the chip row as one group 'Features: Couples-first, Shared goals, ...' — not four separate SR stops
accessibility.touchTarget: ≥44 tall; add hitSlop if visual height is smaller
